competitors.name: Freiberger / Craft Pizza
competitors.action: Freiberger debuted its new Craft Pizza line at Tesco in the UK with six SKUs across thin crust, pinsa, and classic-crust formats, signaling that one of Europe's biggest frozen-pizza manufacturers is still investing in restaurant-style segmentation instead of just line extensions.

competitors.name: Goodfella's / Nomad Foods
competitors.action: Goodfella's is replacing its Takeaway line with a new New York-Style Pizza range, adding hot-honey and loaded-topping cues while rolling into Tesco first and wider UK retail after that, which shows mainstream freezer brands are still chasing premium takeaway-style occasions with trend-led toppings.

competitors.name: Palermo's x Ragu
competitors.action: Palermo's partnered with Ragu on a four-SKU frozen pizza line launching at select retailers in early May, a useful signal that legacy sauce brands still see frozen pizza as a viable extension vehicle and that mainstream shelf players keep borrowing adjacent pantry equity to win trial.

trends.topic: Mainstream frozen pizza is leaning harder into restaurant mimicry and borrowed flavor equity
trends.magnitude: Freiberger launched six Tesco SKUs positioned as fresh-restaurant quality, Goodfella's rebuilt its takeaway line around New York-style and hot honey cues, and Palermo extended Ragu into frozen pizza with four value-priced SKUs.
trends.context: The practical read for Real Dough is that freezer-aisle competition is not standing still on story. Even large-scale players are sharpening a simple occasion-led pitch, whether that is takeaway replacement, trend flavor, or pantry-brand familiarity.

breaking.headline: Today's cleanest signal is that big freezer players keep making the category easier to understand in one sentence
breaking.impact: Freiberger is selling restaurant-quality range architecture, Goodfella's is selling premium fakeaway energy, and Palermo is selling familiar sauce-brand trust. Real Dough should keep tightening its own one-line shelf story around authentic sourdough and Wisconsin credibility instead of broad premium language.
